item.title: Technology-enhanced learning in developing countries: the impact on entrepreneurial education and innovation
item.content:encoded:
This special issue explores how technology-enhanced learning affects entrepreneurial education and innovation in developing countries. The journal invites research examining the intersection of digital tools, entrepreneurial learning, and economic development in contexts with limited resources.

Appel publié par Socio-Economic Planning Sciences. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
